Features:

• GORE-TEX 3L laminate

• Armarcor inserts at camber zones

• 3D Air-Mesh insert on the back

• 2 outside pockets, 1 document pocket

• 1 inside, 1 back and 1 cell phone pocket

• Ventilation zippers in front and back

• front zipper can also be used as ACS (Air-Vent)

• height adjustable waist and hip width adjustment

• Soft collar

• Held Clip-in Technology

• retrofittable Held Drinkbag

Specifications:

• EN 17092, protective clothing for motorcyclists

• D3O® T5 EvoProX soft protectors on shoulder and elbow, EN 1621-1:2012, level 2

• Back protector retrofittable, EN 1621-2:2014

• Rib reinforcement pocket for retrofitting with Art. 9316

• Velcro for retrofittable chest protector Art. 9784 or Art. 92227 EN 1621-3:2018, Level 1

• Reflective inserts

• Connecting zipper
